option_relations.rationale: Eruptive Pruritic Papular Porokeratosis (EPPP) is a rare skin condition characterized by the sudden onset of intensely pruritic papules, which matches the patient's symptoms.
Disseminated Superficial Actinic Porokeratosis (DSAP) is a skin condition that can present with multiple, scattered, erythematous, annular papules, similar to the patient's lesions.
Linear Porokeratosis is a rare skin condition that can present with linear or segmented lesions, which may not exactly match the patient's symptoms.
Disseminated Superficial Porokeratosis (DSP) is a skin condition that can present with multiple, scattered, erythematous, annular papules, similar to the patient's lesions.
